tool.name: RFEM Field Mapper
tool.description: Map random field from structured grid onto arbitrary target mesh

param.name: rf_mat
param.label: RF Reference Material File (.mat or archive)

param.name: target_d
param.label: Target Mesh (.d)
param.help: Arbitrary geometry to map the field onto

param.name: dat_file
param.label: BC Control File (.dat)
param.help: From rfembc_thermal — provides fixed_freedoms count for solver

tool.help:
Maps a spatially correlated random field from a structured reference grid onto an arbitrary target mesh by element centroid proximity.
**Inputs:** - RF mat file: the random field material values from rfemfield_thermal - Target mesh: any .d file (structured or unstructured) - BC dat file: the .dat output from rfembc_thermal — required to carry the correct fixed_freedoms count into the per-instance solver control file
**Algorithm:** For each target element, compute centroid, find the corresponding RF grid cell (i,j,k), assign the RF diffusivity value. Out-of-bounds centroids clamp to the nearest cell.
